top_concerns: Headline '+28% over baseline' compares private-test winners against a public-test baseline and is driven by abstention (accuracy fell 35.3 to 29.3, missing rose to 61%), not like-for-like
Inconsistent dataset statistics (6.5K vs 8K conversations, 15% vs ~18% low-quality egocentric images, margin-of-error claim unsupported for small slices)
GPT-4o judge validation is weak: 99% accuracy inflated by the trivial Missing class, Incorrect precision only 68%, no human agreement or kappa, 75-token truncation

Weak baselines and unfair industry comparison (black-box systems on the live web, unspecified versions, single runs, no CIs, time-sensitive ground truth); multi-turn data generated by Llama, also a baseline
No discussion of privacy, consent and licensing for egocentric images and the 800K-page web corpus; realism of questions and retrieval corpus is by construction
